title: Calendar chips wear the redesign colours, and unbuilt pieces share one Coming soon mark

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-22: Space calendar redesign from Claude Design, plugged into what exists with Coming soon on the rest

detail: FILED 2026-10-22. THE CONSEQUENCE: the calendar chips still wore the old info, broadcast, move and warning tints, so none of the redesign could land. THE FIX: nine calendar tokens (event, in-the-works, to-do and presence) in light and dark, CALENDAR_PRESENTATIONS repainted from them with a 1px hover lift, and one ComingSoonMark (components/ui/coming-soon-mark.tsx) for every piece the design shows that is not built yet. Plan: /mnt/project-files/calendar/calendar-redesign-plan-2026-10-22.md.

verify.note: Fails on main (no cal tokens, no mark), passes with this change.
